entries.english: Hans von Rosenberg and his wife Anna von Kronenberg and his brother Götz sold their Urhausen fortress for 215 florins. Guarantors: Eberhard von Rosenberg, knight, vogt zu Lauda, and Kunz von Rosenberg, resident of Boxberg.
